name: Passkey Step Up
summary: Grants fresh elevated proof only after a user-verifying passkey assertion for the current durable identity.

preconditions.expression: durable-identity == resolved and credential-proof == challenge-issued and session-capability in [authenticated-limited,authenticated-normal]

setup: Issue a passkey step-up challenge requiring user verification.

inputs.description: User-verifying WebAuthn assertion from the secure component.

postconditions.expression: durable-identity == resolved and credential-proof == passkey-proved and session-capability == step-up

sourceReferences.note: isStepUp path requires user verification and records LastMfaDateTimeUtc
